source_text: The eighth-day timing, explicitly commanded (Genesis 17:12; Leviticus 12:3), has been noted in modern times to align with infant physiology: levels of vitamin K and prothrombin (key blood clotting factors) naturally peak around day 8 after birth, reducing hemorrhage risk during the procedure compared to earlier or later days.
